previous_scope.description: A callback and any finite list of preset plain values; invoke the returned function repeatedly with changed values and receivers. Include callback forwarding, results, throws, interleaved instances and no idle calls. Also pass callbacks in returned-call positions 0 through 3 and observe their synchronous invocation inside the original callback, exact identities, results and throws. Later asynchronous descendants require a separate observer. Returned function custom properties are outside the boundary.
